title: Reports audit bulk selection controls
summary: Added Reports Audit bulk-selection controls for selecting all currently visible audit rows, selecting rows at or above an operator-entered score, and clearing selection.
reason: The audit table exposed per-row checkboxes only, making high-score audit triage and rerun CSV staging unnecessarily manual for large audit result sets.
behavior_before: Reports Audit rows could be selected only one row at a time through per-row checkboxes.
behavior_after: Reports Audit includes Select All, Minimum score plus Select Score or Higher, and Clear Selection controls. Bulk selection is scoped to the current filter/search result and still submits only selected row keys to existing backend-owned Ignore/Export actions.
tests_added: Extended tests/python/desktop/test_reports_view_static.py coverage for the new audit selection controls and score-threshold wiring.
Extended tests/webview/test_webview_browser_maintenance_reports_smoke.py coverage for Select All, Clear Selection, and Select Score or Higher.
